--- create_property_graph_named_schema_tables.sql
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH G
NODE TABLES (
  sch.People AS Person,
  sch.Accounts AS Account
)
EDGE TABLES (
  sch.Owns AS Own
    SOURCE KEY (PersonId) REFERENCES Person (Id)
    DESTINATION KEY (AccountId) REFERENCES Account (Id)
)

--- AST
&ast.CreatePropertyGraph{
  Name: &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 22,
    NameEnd: 23,
    Name:    "G",
  },
  Content: &ast.PropertyGraphContent{
    NodeTables: &ast.PropertyGraphNodeTables{
      Node:   24,
      Tables: &ast.PropertyGraphElementList{
        Lparen:   36,
        Rparen:   88,

--- SQL
CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH G NODE TABLES (sch.People AS Person, sch.Accounts AS Account) EDGE TABLES (sch.Owns AS Own SOURCE KEY (PersonId) REFERENCES Person (Id) DESTINATION KEY (AccountId) REFERENCES Account (Id))
